headline: Kenya Airways Introduces Pre-Ordered Inflight Duty-Free Service
summary: Kenya Airways launched an online duty-free shopping service offering up to 15 percent discounts compared to airport stores, delivering pre-ordered goods directly to passengers onboard.
why: Airlines globally are seeking ancillary retail revenue streams to bolster margins amid elevated fuel and operational costs.

impacts.name: Kenya Airways
impacts.why: The carrier is targeting higher ancillary retail revenues through an online pre-order duty-free service.
